backend: old locally linearized penalty KG versus joint 27-node Gaussian-fantasy verification-utility KG
verification_utility: Failed verification earns zero; successful deployment earns clip((5-f)/10,0,1). The declared simulator bounds the true objective within [-5,5]. This operational utility is distinct from the mathematical chance-constrained objective.
verification_power: Use the unchanged Gaussian t/chi-square independent verifier, integrating uncertain constraint mean analytically and log variance/sample variance with 9x12 Gaussian quadrature.
recommendation_only_control: Reuses the exact paid observations and final posterior from penalty search, changes only the final recommendation, and pays its own unchanged validation budget.
risk_ard: Source-only marginal covariance likelihood across independent signed task coefficients, known log-variance label noise and projected task intercepts; nonnegative function variances and 1 percent weak total tail. Mean heads retain conditional source selection.

adaptive_corrected.explanation: Do not force all 68 PIPs to their .05 floor at n0=8; source selection frequencies already encode dictionary selection. Original V2 arm remains a control.

transfer_mixture: Per-head equal prior weights on the source structural model and the fixed-source full dictionary; update weights with pre-observation predictive densities using only paid target observations; retain between-model covariance. Weights stay fixed in Gaussian acquisition fantasies.
primary_comparisons: risk_ard_mixture versus fixed_source under verification_kg in each stratum
paired 384 versus 96 candidate banks on the same functions, initial points, source priors, evaluation and verification budgets
analysis_units: Eight paired seed blocks; candidate rows and the two difficulty layers are not independent samples. Report all strata and negatives without selecting a winning regime.
scoring: Retain feasibility, mathematical feasible regret and old penalized regret; also report realized verified reward, analytically expected verified reward, verifier power and posterior calibration. Simulator truth enters only observation generation and post-decision scoring.
interpretation: No new generator hardness or verifier budget. Separate finite-bank search shortfall from the 384-bank optimum increase. Report extra acquisition compute and retained negative transfer. Neither bank is a continuous optimum.
scope: Public canonical inputs and finite dictionary source priors. Not a learned state/trajectory encoder, a factor-level HVD recovery claim or a high-dimensional guarantee.
candidate_expansion: Nested public coordinates from the same seed; initial IDs are drawn by the original 96-bank RNG. Keep the 96-bank feature centering/scaling and source priors fixed. Additional candidate truth is withheld until post-decision scoring.
